title: shims/super/cc: update swift path
body:
We had to change path since Swift Build 6.4.0 no longer allowed the previous layout. Although there is an upstream PR to restore support (`https://github.com/swiftlang/swift-build/pull/1759`), it should be fine to keep `usr/` paths given it seems closer to upstream preference.

Will note that I'm not sure if this is actually used. Haven't seen any failures from incorrect path, but will keep around to be safe.

Can see result of which paths exist/don't from irb:
```console
$ brew info swift | head -4
==> swift: stable 6.4.0 (bottled)
High-performance system programming language
https://www.swift.org
Installed (on request)
```
```ruby
==> Interactive Homebrew Shell
Example commands available with: `brew irb --examples`
brew(main):001> File.exist? "#{ENV["HOMEBREW_PREFIX"]}/opt/swift/libexec/bin/clang++"
=> false
brew(main):002> File.exist? "#{ENV["HOMEBREW_PREFIX"]}/opt/swift/libexec/usr/bin/clang++"
=> true
brew(main):003> File.exist? "#{ENV["HOMEBREW_PREFIX"]}/opt/swift/libexec/bin/clang"
=> false
brew(main):004> File.exist? "#{ENV["HOMEBREW_PREFIX"]}/opt/swift/libexec/usr/bin/clang"
=> true
```
